name: Markolines Pavement Technologi
summary: Markolines Pavement Technologies Ltd., established in 2002 and headquartered in Navi Mumbai, provides highway operations and maintenance across India through Highway Maintenance Services and Specialized Construction Services divisions. Formerly Markolines Traffic Controls Limited, it was renamed in October 2021. Its maintenance work includes consultancy and bituminous pavement repair such as milling, overlaying and rehabilitation.
